title: TracebackInfo.from_dict does not rebuild Callpoint objects, so it does not invert to_dict
input: ti = TracebackInfo.from_traceback() for a caught ValueError; d = ti.to_dict()
expected: from_dict(d) yields a TracebackInfo whose frames are Callpoints, so to_dict() and str() work and to_dict() equals d
actual: frames stay plain dicts; ti2.to_dict() raises AttributeError: 'dict' object has no attribute 'to_dict' (str(ti2) fails too)
evidence: Docstring: 'Complements TracebackInfo.to_dict'. The source is `return cls(d['frames'])` with a '# TODO: check this.' comment.
